PREFIX ref: <https://reference.example.org/>
SELECT ?s ?class ?tsid ?iri
WHERE {
  ?s ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid.
  ?s brick:hasSubclass* ?class ; rdf:type ?t.
  FILTER (CONTAINS(str(?s), "Core_top"))
}
LIMIT 50

  ?zone rdfs:label "Core_top"; rdf:type brick:Zone.
  ?temp brick:isPointOf ?zone; rdf:type brick:AirTemperature.
  ?set brick:isPointOf ?zone.
  ?set rdf:type ?sclass.
  FILTER (CONTAINS(str(?sclass), "CoolingSetpoint"))
  ?temp rdf:type ?tclass.
}
